locations.note: Minsk: the frozen city in the ice age of 2142, a multiplayer map.
Fall of Berlin: the Pan Asian Coalition's assault on the ruined capital, a multiplayer map.
Verdun: the old battlefield fought over again under the ice, a multiplayer map.
Cerbere Landing: the European Union's beach landing at the Spanish border, a multiplayer map.
Belgrade: a multiplayer map through the Serbian capital.
Camp Gibraltar: the EU's base on the Rock, a multiplayer map.
Suez Canal: a multiplayer map across the canal.
Tunis Harbor: a multiplayer map in the port, where Africa is still ice-free.
Sidi Power Plant: a desert power station, a multiplayer map.
Shuhia Taiba: a desert town in Egypt, a multiplayer map.
Bridge at Remagen: a Northern Strike map at the Rhine bridge.
Liberation of Leipzig: a Northern Strike map through the city.
Port Bavaria: a Northern Strike map at a mountain port in the Bavarian Alps.
Molokai: a late patch map on the Hawaiian island.
Yellowknife: a late patch map in the Canadian north.
